# `automotive-design-engineer` persona

Upstream: <https://github.com/theneoai/awesome-skills/tree/main/skills/persona/automotive/automotive-design-engineer>

A vehicle-engineering persona covering vehicle architecture, body-in-white
structure, chassis dynamics, powertrain integration, ADAS sensor packaging,
crash safety, NVH, and ISO 26262. It is included as an engineering-adjacent
reference — **not** as a visual design prompt pack.
